plan.archetype: Poison scaling with efficient attacks and dexterity defense
plan.bossPrep: Establish poison and dexterity during sleep. Upgrade key poison sources, retain reliable block, and bring potions to withstand attacks and repeated attribute drains.
plan.summary: Take efficient damage early, then build poison and dexterity with draw. Add useful area damage, remove basics gradually, and fight elites only with adequate health and potions.

plan.archetype: Poison scaling with efficient defense and draw
plan.bossPrep: Build poison and dexterity during sleep. Upgrade poison scaling or Neutralize when healthy; preserve reliable block and bring potions for attacks after attribute drains.
plan.summary: Recover now and delay the elite until after another rest. Two Snakebites provide initial poison; prioritize sustained poison, dexterity, and draw. Avoid more expensive attacks, remove Strikes, and upgrade core cards when safe.

plan.archetype: Poison scaling with efficient defense and draw
plan.bossPrep: Establish Accelerant during sleep, then stack poison and Bubble Bubble. Use poison potion to accelerate damage, shivs before strength drains, and block to preserve the poison window.
plan.summary: Existing poison supplies scaling; prioritize defense and draw rather than more expensive poison cards. Remove Strikes, upgrade core powers when safe, and avoid elites until survival improves. Boss damage estimates remain unavailable.

plan.archetype: Poison scaling with dexterity, efficient defense, and draw
plan.bossPrep: Establish Accelerant and Footwork early. Burst poison to overcome healing; preserve defensive potions and Piercing Wail for multihits. Respect any card-play limit.
plan.summary: Take reliable extra energy and the three-rest, no-elite route. Buy defense and draw, remove Strikes, and prioritize Accelerant upgrades when healthy. Existing poison needs stronger survival support, not more expensive sources.
